seo.description: A short guided walkthrough to tell us about your trade business so we can recommend the right plan.

header.heading: Start Your Site
header.lead: A short guided walkthrough — about 2 minutes. Six quick steps so we understand your business and can give you a real, considered recommendation. Most trade businesses land on the Complete Site at $399/mo — this confirms it's the right call for yours.

form.subject: New site start from jobsite.systems
form.successMessage: Got it — your details are in. We'll review everything and get back to you within one business day with a real response, not an auto-reply.
form.errorMessage: Something went wrong. Please try again or email us directly at hello@jobsite.systems.

steps.title: Where are you starting from?
steps.description: Pick the option that best fits. Don't worry about getting it perfect — we can refine on the call.

options.label: Directory listing only
options.description: Angi / HomeAdvisor / Houzz / similar — and that's it.

options.label: DIY site that isn't working
options.description: Built it myself and want to replace it.

options.label: Old WordPress site
options.description: Neglected, broken, or hasn't been updated in years.

options.label: Something Else
options.description: Tell us in the details step.

steps.title: What does your site need?
steps.description: Select everything that applies. The Complete Site at $399/mo bundles all of these — picking helps us confirm which matter most for your business.

options.label: Not sure what I need
options.description: Skip this step — we'll figure out the right features together on the call.

steps.title: Want business email on your domain?
steps.description: Real email like you@yourbusiness.com — $10/mo per address. Setup, DNS, spam protection, and ongoing support included. Completely optional.

options.label: No, skip
options.description: Not interested in business email right now.

options.label: Yes — 1 address
options.description: One mailbox on my domain (e.g., hello@yourbusiness.com).

options.label: Yes — 2 or 3 addresses
options.description: A couple of mailboxes for different roles or crew leads.

options.label: Yes — 4 or more
options.description: Multiple mailboxes for crew, dispatch, or separate inboxes.

options.label: Tell me more first
options.description: I'd like to hear the details before deciding.

steps.title: When do you need it?
steps.description: An honest answer helps us plan. We don't penalize tight timelines — we just need to know.

options.label: Before busy season
options.description: Lining up alongside spring or fall demand.

steps.title: Which plan looks right?
steps.description: Most trade businesses pick the Complete Site at $399/mo — bundles all six systems on yearly billing, 30% off the launch price. Rough sense is fine here; we'll confirm on the call.

extraOptions.label: One-Time Build
extraOptions.description: One-off build — see the pricing page for current options. You own the files.

extraOptions.label: Not Sure Yet
extraOptions.description: Let us recommend on the call.

steps.title: How do we reach you?
steps.description: The basics — so we can follow up personally.

steps.title: Tell us more.
steps.description: Trades you focus on, certifications or specialties, towns or counties you cover — the more context, the sharper our response.
